news_items.headline: Rockwell Automation surges after blowout fiscal Q2 2026 earnings beat
news_items.summary: Rockwell beat both EPS and revenue consensus for fiscal Q2 2026 (adjusted EPS $3.30) with margin expansion and higher volumes. Stock moved up 10.72% on May 5.

news_items.headline: Rockwell Automation raises FY26 adjusted EPS guide to $12.50-$13.10
news_items.summary: Management lifted FY26 adjusted EPS view to $12.50-$13.10 and raised reported and organic sales growth ranges, citing demand strength in warehouse automation, data centers, and semiconductors.

news_items.headline: Rockwell Automation (ROK) jumps 10.72% on May 5 following Q2 results
news_items.summary: ROK posted a 10.72% single-day gain on May 5, 2026, driven by stronger-than-expected fiscal Q2 2026 earnings and raised full-year outlook.

news_items.headline: ROK declares quarterly dividend of $1.38 per share, payable to holders of record May 18
news_items.summary: Quarterly dividend of $1.38/share declared ($5.52 annualized, ~1.3% yield); record date May 18. Same article notes Truist Financial cut its ROK stake by 24.5% in its Q4 13F filing.

news_items.headline: ROK dips 0.5% on May 4, 2026 ahead of earnings
news_items.summary: Modest -0.5% pullback on May 4 ahead of the fiscal Q2 2026 earnings release that landed on May 5.

news_items.headline: Plex Smart Manufacturing Platform win at Chocolate Shoppe Ice Cream highlights ROK SaaS traction
news_items.summary: Plex platform deployment at Chocolate Shoppe Ice Cream cited as evidence of Rockwell's software/SaaS-led growth catalyst, with customer reporting inventory accuracy, waste reduction, and quality control gains.
